decisions.reason: The mobile-modular processing concept (MMAK) has a documented customer success with over €600,000 in annual savings and fits the firm's modular strategy, so it is worth keeping.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is a core product line with its own dedicated page in both years, so a near-term withdrawal is unlikely.
This concept is the same MMAK offering, with a named reference customer and quantified savings, which supports keeping it as a strategic modular solution.
The slow-speed shredder series launched only in 2024 is close to the established offer and has its own dedicated page, so it is likely to stay through the coming year.
The spiral shaft screens are recent and broaden the screening portfolio after the trommel screen was dropped, so the firm will likely keep them.
